prompt: Implement a data service with health checks, add tests, then handle a requirement change to add caching.

stages.name: Implement Service
stages.prompt: Implement service.py with a DataService class that has get_data() returning {'status': 'ok'} and is_healthy() returning True.

stages.name: Write Tests
stages.prompt: Write tests in tests/test_service.py that verify both methods.

stages.name: Add Caching
stages.prompt: Add a simple in-memory cache to DataService.get_data() that caches results for 60 seconds.
